rule: Portable private evidence and generated Challenge shapes. The v1 wire format is retained for compatibility; study_day is provenance, not a mandatory next-day schedule. This file stores no personal state and is not lexical semantic authority.

compatibility.missing_evidence_fields: Do not fabricate event identity, target revision, task attribution, demand, assistance, novelty, validity, or delayed separation. Missing fields limit inference and cannot automatically admit or retire Repair.
compatibility.migration_rule: Legacy Unknown/Fuzzy and whole-card revisit history cannot automatically create full-card Repair. Only explicit local + targets may migrate as active evidence; repeated compatibility migration of the same exact legacy target is idempotent and is not re-exported as a new learner event.

event_fields.word: Optional display spelling; never semantic authority.
event_fields.target_kind: card | core | sense | secondary_sense | collocation | construction | phrase | relation | word_feel | form_identity | productive_need
event_fields.target_id: Stable Current subobject identity when available.
event_fields.target_locator: Owner-local locator with owner revision/fingerprint when no stable ID exists. An unversioned array index is insufficient for durable inference.
event_fields.source: card_routing | depth_plus | manual_clear | challenge | reconstruction | reading | cloze | translation | writing | blind_probe
event_fields.outcome: UNKNOWN | FUZZY | KNOWN | MASTERED | ADDED | CLEAR | REACTIVATED | CORRECT | WRONG | SLOW | AGAIN | QUESTION_ISSUE | SEMANTIC_ISSUE
event_fields.correct_key: Optional correct spatial answer key, only after the learner answers.
event_fields.question_trace: Optional minimal prompt/options trace for diagnosis; not a replacement semantic owner.
event_fields.note: Optional diagnostic note, never a required ordinary learner action.
event_fields.observed_at: Occurrence time in ISO-8601, distinct from import/export time.

optional_evidence_enrichment.event_id: Stable source event identity for idempotent replay; conflicting reuse is quarantined.
optional_evidence_enrichment.context_id: Identifies repeated versus distinct evidence contexts.
optional_evidence_enrichment.target_revision: Owner revision or target fingerprint when needed to resolve identity.
optional_evidence_enrichment.demand: recognition | discrimination | production when observed and material.
optional_evidence_enrichment.attribution: lexical | non_lexical | unresolved. English-task WRONG/AGAIN/SLOW/CORRECT cannot be used as lexical admission/retirement evidence unless the exact target is resolved and attribution is lexical.
optional_evidence_enrichment.assistance: Observed assistance/answer exposure, not an inferred default of unassisted.
optional_evidence_enrichment.context_novelty: Observed fresh/unseen/repeated context; unavailable is not unseen.
optional_evidence_enrichment.delayed: Explicit boolean that the observation is meaningfully separated from answer exposure/initial repair; absence is not true.
optional_evidence_enrichment.question_valid: For Challenge/reconstruction/probe scoring evidence, explicit true means the generated question is accepted as valid; false marks a defect; absence is not silently upgraded to valid.
optional_evidence_enrichment.corrects_event_id: Explicit defect/correction linkage. A correction can withdraw only an event for the same exact Word/target and, when both carry challenge IDs, the same Challenge.

rules: Keep exact target references rather than duplicated whole definitions.
Meaningful events inform the next relevant compilation, not a compulsory next-day review queue.
Re-importing one event cannot create additional debt or independent successes.
Whole-card Unknown/Fuzzy routes Depth now and does not by itself admit any Repair target.
Manual clear means learner agency and DORMANT, not demonstrated mastery; CLEAR/REACTIVATED remain exportable evidence so another compiler can reproduce the decision history.
A defective question is not learner failure; unresolved target or task attribution cannot silently become vocabulary debt.
Immediate assisted reconstruction is not delayed transfer; a correct English answer is not success for every word in the passage.
Return Packet remains private and must not be committed as shared content.

challenge_fields.target_kind: core | sense | secondary_sense | collocation | construction | phrase | relation | word_feel | form_identity | productive_need
challenge_fields.target_id: Stable Current subobject identity when available.
challenge_fields.target_revision: Optional exact Current owner/target revision for locator-only targets.
challenge_fields.source_evidence: Exact local + or qualified target-level failure/uncertainty, or explicitly optional probe. Whole-card Fuzzy alone is not admission evidence.
challenge_fields.demand: Optional recognition | discrimination | production requirement for this target.
challenge_fields.evidence_quality: Optional observed/compiled metadata such as target_revision, demand, assistance, context_novelty, delayed and attribution. Missing values stay unknown; they must never be upgraded to strong evidence merely because the answer is correct.
challenge_fields.question_type: spatial_choice for v1; later versions may add other low-friction forms.
challenge_fields.stem: Generated context from accepted Current semantics. Never consume protected unseen true-exam/TPO material.
challenge_fields.options: 2-4 objects with keys in left | up | right | down and learner-visible text.
challenge_fields.correct_key: One spatial key present in options.
challenge_fields.repair: Optional smallest-sufficient repair shown only after failure.
challenge_fields.reconstruction: Optional one same-session reconstruction, without recursive repair chains; not independent delayed stability evidence.

rules: Generate from valid Current lexical semantics and relations, not one permanent item per sense.
Do not consume unattempted held-out true-exam/TPO source sentences.
Two-choice items normally use left/right; other spatial choices remain consistent.
Arrow choice submits immediately without a ritual second Enter.
One correct Challenge does not automatically retire Repair. Dormancy requires explicitly qualifying target/demand-matched evidence; same-session reconstruction never supplies delayed evidence.
A scored Challenge event produced by the runtime carries question_valid=true only after packet validation; a later QUESTION_ISSUE may withdraw only its own exact corrected target event.
Preserve valid failure history even after same-session reconstruction succeeds, but do not turn history retention into an unconditional future test obligation.
Retirement/reactivation compares the same target and relevant demand. Reading recognition cannot automatically clear Writing production weakness.
Challenge packets are private transport, not semantic authority or an obligatory daily ritual.

english_objective_lexical_thread.carrier: An optional `lexicalEvidence` object on a `threads[]` entry inside an already accepted kianos.english.objective_review_return.v1 payload whose route is exactly `lexical`.
english_objective_lexical_thread.purpose: Bridge a Chat-resolved exact lexical observation from Reading A / Reading B / Cloze (and compatible future Translation/Writing review surfaces) into the shared Lexical evidence ledger without creating a duplicate English SRS.
required_for_import: task occurrence time via lexicalEvidence.observed_at or the submitted English attempt

lexicalEvidence_fields.target_kind: Exact lexical repair-unit kind; card-level routing is invalid here.
lexicalEvidence_fields.target_locator: Allowed only with target_revision when no stable target ID exists.
lexicalEvidence_fields.target_label: Optional display label; not semantic authority.
lexicalEvidence_fields.outcome: WRONG | AGAIN | SLOW | CORRECT. No default is inferred.
lexicalEvidence_fields.demand: Optional recognition | discrimination | production when actually observed.
lexicalEvidence_fields.assistance: Optional assisted | unassisted when actually observed.
lexicalEvidence_fields.context_novelty: Optional unseen | fresh | repeated when actually observed.
lexicalEvidence_fields.delayed: Optional boolean; absence is not true.
lexicalEvidence_fields.observed_at: Optional explicit occurrence time. Otherwise the submitted English attempt time is used, never import time.
lexicalEvidence_fields.event_id: Optional stable event identity. Otherwise the bridge deterministically derives one from task/object/thread/target/outcome.

rules: The English review importer must first accept and persist the parent review thread; the lexical bridge cannot bypass a rejected English return.
route=lexical is the explicit lexical attribution decision. A vague or unresolved thread without exact Current target identity is rejected and creates no Repair.
Reading A and Reading B map to lexical source=reading; Cloze maps to source=cloze. Later Translation/Writing surfaces may map only when their own accepted return path exists.
Re-import is idempotent. Same event identity with a conflicting payload is quarantined.

A lexical WRONG/AGAIN can activate only its exact target. SLOW remains weak evidence under the Evidence/Memory contract. CORRECT can retire only when the same target/demand and explicit quality conditions justify dormancy.
Cross-module evidence remains private browser state and never mutates shared lexical Content owners.

chat_compile_order: resolve identities, deduplicate and reconcile event chronology/corrections
derive exact target eligibility from local + and qualified meaningful evidence
withdraw stale/invalid debt and consider target/demand-matched later evidence
diagnose repeated failure instead of adding mechanical repetitions
select a small useful Repair subset from current evidence and learner capacity
preserve Coverage continuation; optional probes never become quotas or prerequisites
no_review_debt_rule: Missed days create no due-card debt. Compile from currently valid evidence; no all-due-before-new gate. Opening full Depth can end with zero Repair, and Kian may skip/defer Repair without losing Coverage resume.
